name: Deaf And Dumb Demons
overview: Scripture reveals that demons can afflict individuals with physical ailments such as muteness and deafness, as seen when Jesus healed a man possessed by a dumb and blind spirit, restoring his ability to speak and see (Matthew 12:22; Luke 11:14). Jesus demonstrated authority over these unclean spirits by casting them out and commanding them to leave, even addressing a 'dumb and deaf spirit' directly to expel it (Mark 9:25; Matthew 10:1). The LORD is sovereign over all creation, including those who are mute or deaf, affirming His power over both physical conditions and demonic forces (Exodus 4:11). Though demons acknowledge the one true God and tremble, their belief does not save, underscoring the need for Christ's deliverance from their oppression (James 2:19).
